endorsements.name: Pedro "hkm" Joaquin
endorsements.label: Attacks Against 2wire Residential Gateways
endorsements.description: Some time ago there was a vulnerability in 2wire residential routers that allowed DNS Poisoning via Cross Site Request Forgery, this was widely exploited in Mexico where this router is most commonly used. The patch actually contained an Authentication Bypass vulnerability that made things worse, and now, after the patch got patched, there are still many public unpatched vulnerabilities that plague this device.
